notes.title: Soul Split Demo - Patch 1.1.2
notes.notes:
Hi everyone, hope your enjoying the demo! Here are the notes for our most recent patch - 1.1.2

Notes:
- Spell bar shows cooldowns for spells
- Spells reset to default when brought back to hub world
- Music plays on all dungeon floors
- Fixed Archivist spawning in the middle of the room
- Slightly reduced the health of The Archivist
- Tweaked The Archivist's healthbar
- Made knights more likely to use spells
- Adjusted resistances of all enemies
- Made Seething cores slightly larger
- Various spelltable tweaks 
- Various spell tweaks
- Reduced size of the mini-map
- Reduced size of currency tracker
- Increased amount of currency given by all enemies

notes.title: Soul Split Demo 1.1.1 Patch Notes
notes.notes:
Happy Going Rogue Festival everybody! The Soul Split Demo is back up and we excited to show off what we've been working on. There will be more updates throughout the week so keep checking in to see what changes!

Fixes:
- dropped spells can always be picked back up
- health fully restored when going back to hub world
- starting loadout applied when going back to hub world
- hitting esc key while in spell table no longer causes camera issues
- no longer lose ability to shoot after death in certain scenarios

notes.title: 1.0.3 Patch Notes
notes.notes:
Hi everyone, the team is still hard at work fixing as many bugs as we can! With todays update dungeons should be much more stable and we have added a new item (Health Jars) to some rooms. Health Jars will provide a large amount of healing when picked up so keep your eyes out for them. 

Patch Notes:

Fixes:
- Dungeons not having an exit room to the next floor
- Dungeons spawning 2 rooms on top of each other
- Boss Room not accessible in 3rd floor
- Music progression on first floor

Updates:
- Health Jars drop in some rooms instead of spells

notes.title: Patch 1.0.2 Is Live!
notes.notes:
Hi everyone, another patch is live tonight! We are continuing to identify and fix bugs as quickly as possible. Hope you are all having fun with the demo!

1.0.2 Patch Notes

Fixes 
- Tutorial Level Geo Clipping Issues
- Stable Menu Navigation
- Loading to hub world from menu infinite loading screen
- Spell Costs in Unlock Table change from red to yellow when enough currency is available to purchase
- Enemy Cores AI Balancing 
- crosshair inactive while in menus
- Ice Wisps damage reduced by 35%
- All Spell costs reduced

notes.title: Soul Split Demo Patch Notes 1.0.1
notes.notes:
Thank you to everyone who has been downloading and playing the Soul Split Demo! We just released a small patch fixing some of the most glaring bugs in the build. We will have more updates coming throughout the week. 

We would also like to direct you to our Feedback & Bug Reporting forums here:

Feedback: https://steamcommunity.com/app/1842040/discussions/2/

Bug Reporting: https://steamcommunity.com/app/1842040/discussions/1/

We would love to hear your feedback on the game!

Patch Notes 1.0.1

Fixes
-    Fixed Return button on Pause menu
-    Fixed cursor disappearing acts
-    Fixed some issues with audio options menu
-    Fixed a bug where the boss music wasn’t properly resetting
-    Minor audio and music adjustments
-    Fixed doors not locking properly during combat
-    Fixed boss not resetting
-    Fixed input buttons sometimes triggering after death
-    Fixed Enemies spawning in walls
Updates
-    Character color scheme matches steam banner
-    Spell Pool updated
-    Possessed Armor walk animations
-    Added spell table to starting room of every dungeon
-    Added target dummies in the starting room of every dungeon
-    Tweaked various spell damage values
-    Flying book enemy visibility
-    New reticle sprite
